nodes.title: IMPORTANT - SOURCE VIDEO
widgets_values:
POSE TRANSFER WORKFLOW

Upload the motion-reference video here. DWPose converts every frame to a pose guide.

IMPORTANT: the control-frame count must match the H3 generation length. This workflow's normal 5-second setting produces 124 H3 frames. For the first test, use a source clip that yields 124 frames at 24 fps (about 5.17 seconds), or set the H3 duration/length to match the pose batch.

nodes.title: 4. Match Pose Frames to H3 Resolution

widgets_values: The person in the reference image performs natural full-body movement while maintaining the same identity, face, hairstyle, clothing and overall appearance. Smooth realistic body motion, accurate anatomy, natural balance and weight shifting, consistent proportions, stable hands and limbs, subtle secondary motion in hair and clothing. The camera remains steady and keeps the person clearly framed. Photorealistic, cinematic, temporally consistent, no morphing, no identity change, no extra limbs, no distorted anatomy.
